policy: Pixels are captured only where a licence explicitly permits it, on the user's machine by `first-draft-axi refs pull`, into a local cache; this package ships the list, never third-party screenshots. Every other product is kept as written notes and a link.

entries.name: Supabase
entries.why: Source-code Apache-2.0 permission does not clearly resolve the hosted site's IP/copy restrictions at https://supabase.com/terms; explicit screenshot permission is unclear, so notes and link only (reviewed 2026-10-24).
entries.notes: Developer platform landing: a short benefit headline, two clear actions, the real product (dashboard, code) shown early, customer logos, dense but calm dark surfaces with one green accent.

entries.notes: Docs page: left section nav, readable 65-character column, an on-this-page outline, code blocks with copy, clear heading steps.

entries.name: GOV.UK Design System

permission.quote: Open Government Licence v3.0 , except where otherwise stated
permission.basis: The site's footer puts all its content under the Open Government Licence v3.0, which permits copying and publishing.

entries.notes: Plain-language docs: large confident headings, one blue link colour, generous spacing, no decoration, everything readable at 390.

entries.name: Linear
entries.notes: Dark, precise product landing: a short exact headline, the real app screen as the hero, thin 1 px borders, restrained gradient light, Inter-like type with tight tracking, and an app UI dense with real issue data.

entries.name: Stripe
entries.notes: Confident landing: one bold headline over a signature gradient, customer logos and real numbers as proof, product screens in device frames; its docs pair prose with live code in two columns.

entries.name: Vercel
entries.notes: Black and white with one accent, Geist type, a grid of 1 px lines, the product (deploys, previews) shown as UI; its dashboard is a quiet list of projects with status dots.

entries.name: Raycast
entries.notes: Dark, glossy but focused: the command bar itself is the hero, keyboard shortcuts as visual motif, one red accent, crisp product shots.

entries.name: Arc
entries.notes: Warm, playful product landing: a big friendly headline, hand-made colour, the browser shown in use, very short copy.

entries.name: PostHog
entries.why: its site licence asks others not to copy or use the website
entries.notes: A deliberately distinctive, desktop-like site with hand-drawn characters and dense real product screens.

entries.name: Notion
entries.notes: Notes app: a quiet sidebar of pages, a wide calm editor with a big page title, icons and covers as the only colour, black on white, generous line height.

entries.name: Bear
entries.notes: Notes app: three panes (tags, note list with previews, editor), one red accent, a serif-free writing face at a comfortable measure, Markdown made pretty.

entries.name: Things
entries.notes: Productivity app: lots of white, one blue, a small set of clear list views (Today, Upcoming), checkboxes and quiet detail; delight comes from restraint.

entries.name: Craft
entries.notes: Documents app: card-like blocks, soft colour, large type, page previews; feels like a designed document rather than a form.

entries.name: mellow onboarding
entries.notes: Owner-supplied 6-screen mobile onboarding: one little ink-line character with a soft watercolour wash on every screen, a warm cream ground with sage and soft peach accents (one accent per screen), one shared shell (header with back and Skip, one title position, progress dots, round next button) and generous whitespace.
entries.why: Supplied as an image by the owner, not a public page with a licence to capture: it is passed to make as --ref (the onboarding-flow journey does) and judged beside the design there, and it is never copied into the package.
